A base sherd fragment from a Roman Central Gaulish samian ware cup or small bowl possibly Dragendorff Form 33 dating to AD 110 - 145. The sherd has a chamfered foot ring base. In the centre of the base is a maker's stamp reading ANNIOSF this is stamp from the Potter Annius ii who was working in Lezoux and Les Martres-de-Veyre.
